summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py, placed between print and print_exception. It joins str(obj) for each object with sep, then calls self.print once with end, style, and highlight passed through, and emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False. highlight defaults to True. Added tests in tests/test_console.py after test_print_style: test_out, test_out_empty, test_out_markup, test_out_emoji, test_out_containers, test_out_no_crop, test_out_style, test_out_highlight_default, test_out_highlight_none, test_out_highlight_false, test_out_render_hook. Added "Added Console.out" to CHANGELOG.md under 9.0.0 Added. Added a "Low level output" section to docs/source/console.rst after Logging. Tests were not run, per instructions. highlight is annotated bool = True rather than Optional[bool] because Optional is not imported in console.py.
